name: Dehydrated
text: You have lost more water than you can spare.

effects.text: +1 Difficulty to all MOVE and BATTLE tests

healBy: Drink at least a litre and rest in shade or a sealed shelter.

name: Exposed
text: Sun, sand or cold has worn you down.

name: Spice Withdrawal
text: Your body demands the spice it has learned to need.

effects.text: Suffer 1 Stress at the start of each scene

healBy: A dose of spice, or a week of medical care and DISCIPLINE (D3).

name: Wounded
text: An injury slows you and hurts with every movement.

effects.text: +1 Difficulty to MOVE and BATTLE tests

healBy: Field Surgery or a medical kit and a scene of rest.

name: Poisoned
text: A poison is working through your body.

effects.text: Suffer 2 Stress at the end of each scene until treated

healBy: Antidote kit, a Suk doctor, or a DISCIPLINE (D3) test to purge it.

name: Exhausted
text: You need sleep more than anything.

effects.text: Cannot spend Momentum on your own tests

name: Disgraced
text: Your reputation has suffered in public.

effects.text: +1 Difficulty to COMMUNICATE tests with nobility

healBy: A public act of restitution or a victory witnessed by peers.

name: Suspected
text: Someone powerful believes you are a traitor or spy.

effects.text: The Narrator may spend 1 Threat to have you watched in any scene

healBy: Clear your name with evidence or a powerful ally.

name: Spice-Addicted
text: You are bound to melange. Your eyes are slowly turning blue.

effects.text: Must consume spice every few days or gain spice withdrawal

healBy: There is no cure; only a steady supply.

name: Indebted
text: You owe a debt to someone who will collect.

effects.text: Once per adventure the creditor can demand a service

name: Marked for Death
text: An assassin has been paid to kill you.

effects.text: The Narrator gains 2 Threat at the start of each session to spend on attempts

healBy: Kill or turn the assassin, or the one who paid.

name: Sand-Blind
text: Grit and glare have stolen your sight for now.

effects.text: +2 Difficulty to any test that relies on sight

healBy: Clean water and a day out of the glare.

name: Shaken
text: Fear has its claws in you.
healBy: Pass a DISCIPLINE (D1) test or end the scene.
